packageRules.description: Every plugin update: the enforcer holds consumers to Maven [3.6.3,), and CI here runs only a newer Maven
prBodyNotes: Check the new version's `requiredMavenVersion` (`META-INF/maven/plugin.xml` in the jar) against the `[3.6.3,)` the enforcer rule declares. CI here runs a newer Maven and does not catch a raised floor. Update any pom comment or README line that cites the old version.

packageRules.description: Apache Maven plugins the build runs on every PR move together; release-only and analysis plugins are excluded below
Analysis engines pinned to the versions in octopus-base gradle-quality-plugin/gradle.properties; they move with it, on request from the Dependency Dashboard
Run only in a real release (mvn deploy -P gpg), which no PR check exercises; created on request from the Dependency Dashboard
